headline_en: The current architecture is disclosed; the current trading rules are not.
headline_zh: 当前架构已披露，但当前交易规则仍未披露。

current.portfolio_shape_en: Long-only ETF/Treasury/cash model; current public evidence does not establish option contracts as portfolio holdings.
current.portfolio_shape_zh: 多头 ETF／短期国债／现金模型；当前公开证据并未证明期权合约属于组合持仓。
current.options_context_en: Signal Sigma options positioning is shown beside the ETF state; its exact deterministic authority is unresolved.
current.options_context_zh: Signal Sigma 期权仓位信息与 ETF 状态并列展示；其是否具有确定性的组合决策权限仍未确定。

authority.line_en: Research context only — no rank, size, gate, portfolio or trading authority.
authority.line_zh: 仅作研究背景－不产生排序、仓位、准入、组合或交易权限。

timeline.detail_en: SPX / IEMG / GLD / BTC-or-IBIT construction; flat outside structural dislocations; Donald Jones auction-market exit disclosed as the winner among tested exits.
timeline.detail_zh: SPX／IEMG／GLD／BTC 或 IBIT 结构；结构性错位之外保持空仓；披露 Donald Jones 拍卖市场退出法在所测退出法中胜出。

timeline.detail_en: Dual-KAMA regime detection, hysteresis, ATR-normalized dislocation trigger, HYG/IEI veto, GEX tilt and SPY/QQQ/GLD/BIL weighting were disclosed.
timeline.detail_zh: 披露双 KAMA 状态识别、滞后机制、ATR 标准化错位触发、HYG/IEI 否决、GEX 倾斜以及 SPY/QQQ/GLD/BIL 权重。

timeline.detail_en: A live-state disclosure showed 25% SPY / 75% BIL with QQQ and GLD flat — evidence for that generation, not a rule for September.
timeline.detail_zh: 实时状态披露为 25% SPY／75% BIL，QQQ 与 GLD 为空仓－这是该版本的证据，并非九月版本的规则。

timeline.title_zh: 指数基础仓＋有限风险错位版本
timeline.detail_en: Long index base with defined-risk QQQ/GLD dislocation trades. The later auction-profile reconstruction null belongs only to this tested family.
timeline.detail_zh: 指数多头基础仓配合有限风险的 QQQ／GLD 错位交易。后续拍卖轮廓复刻的空结果只适用于这一被测家族。

timeline.title_en: Current Trend Base + Dislocation Overlay generation
timeline.title_zh: 当前 Trend Base＋Dislocation Overlay 版本
timeline.detail_en: SPY, XLE, GLD and SHY; two independent engines; current product pages share one engine run/data pull and are explicitly model output rather than a brokerage record.
timeline.detail_zh: 标的为 SPY、XLE、GLD 与 SHY；两个独立引擎；当前产品页面共享一次引擎运行／数据拉取，并明确属于模型输出而非券商账户记录。

claim_ledger.claim_en: Investable set is SPY, XLE, GLD plus short-duration Treasury ETF SHY.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 可投资标的是 SPY、XLE、GLD，加短久期国债 ETF SHY。

claim_ledger.claim_en: Architecture uses two independent engines named Trend Base and Dislocation Overlay.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 架构使用两个独立引擎：Trend Base 与 Dislocation Overlay。

claim_ledger.claim_en: Full evaluation window is 2004–2026; $200k grows to about $10.08m; annualized return 19.7%; max drawdown -7.9%; Calmar/MAR 2.51 versus 0.20 for the S&P 500.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 完整评估窗口为 2004–2026；20 万美元增长至约 1,008 万美元；年化回报 19.7%；最大回撤 -7.9%；Calmar/MAR 为 2.51，对比标普 500 的 0.20。
claim_ledger.state_zh: 发布者主张－尚未独立复现

claim_ledger.claim_en: Current performance and position views come from one engine run and one data pull; figures are model output, not a brokerage record.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 当前业绩与持仓页面来自同一次引擎运行和同一次数据拉取；数字属于模型输出，而非券商账户记录。

claim_ledger.claim_en: The tested August auction-profile exit family did not validate a deterministic exit rule.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 被测试的八月拍卖轮廓退出家族未能验证出确定性的退出规则。
claim_ledger.state_zh: 未验证出退出规则－仅限八月被测家族

claim_ledger.claim_en: Exact current Trend Base transitions, Dislocation Overlay entry/sizing/exit, options-context authority and SHY/cash execution policy are not publicly identified.
claim_ledger.claim_zh: 当前 Trend Base 转换、Dislocation Overlay 入场／仓位／退出、期权背景权限，以及 SHY／现金执行政策的精确规则尚未公开识别。
claim_ledger.state_en: Current Section 3 or equivalent discriminator not recovered
claim_ledger.state_zh: 尚未获得当前 Section 3 或等价判别证据

evidence_partition.summary_en: Current universe, named two-engine architecture and model-vs-brokerage boundary are directly disclosed.
evidence_partition.summary_zh: 当前标的范围、双引擎命名架构以及模型输出与券商记录的边界均为直接披露。

evidence_partition.summary_en: Long-history return, drawdown and risk-adjusted statistics remain attributed claims until a version-matched funded replay reproduces them.
evidence_partition.summary_zh: 长期回报、回撤与风险调整指标仍属于发布者主张，直至用版本匹配、资金化的回放独立复现。

evidence_partition.summary_en: The August auction-profile exit family produced a scoped null; source/version reconciliation independently establishes that September is a materially different generation.
evidence_partition.summary_zh: 八月拍卖轮廓退出家族得到限定范围的空结果；来源／版本核对也独立确认九月属于实质不同的新版本。

evidence_partition.summary_en: The exact current transition, entry, sizing, exit, options-authority and cash/SHY execution rules remain unidentified.
evidence_partition.summary_zh: 当前精确的转换、入场、仓位、退出、期权权限与现金／SHY 执行规则仍未识别。

scoped_results.scope: tested August auction-profile exit family only
scoped_results.scope_zh: 仅限被测试的八月拍卖轮廓退出家族
scoped_results.meaning_en: No deterministic exit in the tested August profile family was validated.
scoped_results.meaning_zh: 被测试的八月轮廓家族中未验证出确定性的退出规则。
scoped_results.does_not_mean_en: This does not mean the current September SCE has no exit rule.
scoped_results.does_not_mean_zh: 这并不意味着当前九月版本的 SCE 没有退出规则。

failed_reconstruction_families.detail_en: Preserved as a scoped negative result; do not generalize it to September.
failed_reconstruction_families.detail_zh: 保留为限定范围的负结果；不得推广到九月版本。

failed_reconstruction_families.detail_en: June Jones exits, July dual-KAMA parameters and August hypotheses are lineage evidence, not missing September rules.
failed_reconstruction_families.detail_zh: 六月 Jones 退出法、七月双 KAMA 参数与八月假设属于谱系证据，不是九月缺失规则的替代品。

failed_reconstruction_families.name_zh: 将期权库存视为当前组合账本
failed_reconstruction_families.detail_en: Current disclosures separate ETF/cash state from options context, so the older option-inventory enumeration is not a current portfolio reconstruction path.
failed_reconstruction_families.detail_zh: 当前披露将 ETF／现金状态与期权背景分开，因此旧的期权库存枚举不再属于当前组合复刻路径。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact Trend Base state variable, warm-up, cash-rotation threshold, hysteresis and sizing.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: Trend Base 的精确状态变量、预热期、现金轮换阈值、滞后机制与仓位。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact Dislocation Overlay entry predicate, eligible-asset selection, overlap policy and sizing.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: Dislocation Overlay 的精确入场条件、合格资产选择、重叠政策与仓位。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact overlay exit/invalidation rule and whether Jones auction-value logic survived into September.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: 叠加层的精确退出／失效规则，以及 Jones 拍卖价值逻辑是否延续至九月。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact authority of daily options positioning: descriptive context, eligibility modifier or deterministic gate.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: 每日期权仓位的精确权限：描述性背景、资格修正，还是确定性准入门槛。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact SHY-versus-cash treatment, distributions, costs, execution clock and rebalance convention.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: SHY 与现金的精确处理、分红、成本、执行时钟与再平衡约定。

unresolved_current_rules.en: Exact rule version behind the published 2004–2026 statistics and whether all current components existed over that full window.
unresolved_current_rules.zh: 公开 2004–2026 统计所对应的精确规则版本，以及当前全部组件是否贯穿该完整窗口。

reopen_event.en: A genuinely new current-version Section 3 or equivalent deterministic disclosure. Reopen identification from that evidence; do not resume proxy tuning from older generations.
reopen_event.zh: 出现真正新的当前版本 Section 3 或等价确定性披露时重新开启识别；必须从该新证据出发，不得恢复旧版本的代理调参。
